Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2022-05.explanation_en: In February 2022 geopolitical risk pushed oil to an 8-year high, with coal supporting petcoke prices [7]. The Russia-Ukraine war then caused havoc for Indian cement makers, who are major petcoke buyers [11], and input costs rose [12]. Supply and logistics disruptions added to this: a Kuwait pipeline fire halted exports in January [3], the Saint John petcoke structure was damaged [10], and the Benicia pier fire in April may have disrupted Bay Area flows [13][14]. The headlines do not give a full price breakdown, so the weighting of these causes is inferred.
Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2022-05.explanation_zh: 2022年2月,地缘风险推动油价升至8年高位,煤炭价格支撑石油焦价格[7]。随后俄乌战争冲击印度水泥企业(石油焦主要买家)[11],投入成本上升[12]。供应与物流扰动进一步加剧:1月科威特管道火灾一度中断出口[3],圣约翰石油焦储存设施受损[10],4月贝尼西亚码头火灾可能影响湾区物流[13][14]。新闻未给出完整的价格分解,各因素权重为推断。
Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2022-05.lesson_en: When geopolitical shocks lift oil and coal, petcoke tends to follow, especially if cement-sector demand and port logistics are also stressed.
Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2022-05.lesson_zh: 地缘冲击推高油价和煤价时,石油焦往往跟涨,若水泥需求与港口物流同时承压,涨幅会更大。

The subsequent fall coincides with new supply signals (Duqm refinery trial operation, Oman petcoke offered to Indian cement firms) and disruption at Venezuela's petcoke trader. None of the headlines directly states the price drop, so the explanation is inferential.

Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2023-06.lesson_en: Watch for new refinery capacity and shifts in Indian import/buying patterns, since prices elevated by tight supply can retrace quickly.
Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2023-06.lesson_zh: 关注新增炼厂产能和印度进口采购模式变化，供应紧张推高的价格可能快速回落。

The headlines give no hard supply-outage data, so the geopolitical and crude-cost link is the best-supported cause.
Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2026-04.explanation_zh: 2026年3月中下旬的报道显示,西亚战争和原油价格上涨推高了石油焦成本,印度水泥企业面临石油焦和包装成本冲击,并预计上调水泥价格[14][17][9][13]。此前1月的展望已提示2026年石油焦价格可能大幅波动[2],更早的预测也指出石油焦相对煤炭的折价在变化[0]。标题中没有具体的供应中断数据,因此地缘冲突与原油成本传导是最有依据的解释。
Green Pet Coke (GPC)|2026-04.lesson_en: Watch crude oil and Middle East geopolitical shocks, since they quickly feed into petcoke costs and Indian cement-sector demand.

Cobalt|2019-03.explanation_en: The headlines do not directly document the fall. Earlier items point to a supply-side picture: artisanal mining expected to balance the market [0], and a Katanga export halt that was expected to lift prices [7] but was followed by audit and controversy [29]. A March 2019 article titled "What's Behind The Cobalt Price Crash" [47] confirms a crash but its content is not shown, so the specific mechanism (likely oversupply after the 2018 boom) is inferred and uncertain.

Cobalt|2019-03.lesson_en: When prices are bid up on supply-disruption hopes, watch for artisanal supply and resumed exports that can quickly reverse the rally.

Forecasts of cobalt demand doubling by 2030 and carmakers' blind spot on input prices point to demand-led tightness. By March, Benchmark was voicing supply-chain concern as battery material prices soared. The headlines give no specific supply outage, so the explanation is mainly demand and sentiment, with moderate confidence.

Cobalt|2021-03.lesson_en: Watch battery-metal indices and EV demand forecasts: a sustained rally in cobalt and nickel, with carmakers unhedged, can extend into a larger price surge.

Cobalt|2022-08.explanation_en: None of the headlines report cobalt price moves or a specific supply or demand event in May–August 2022. The most relevant context is the structural shift toward cobalt-free LFP batteries (Tesla using them in half of new cars) and earlier concern over surging commodity prices hurting EV affordability, which suggests demand-side pressure after a spike. Other items (DR Congo supply chain scrutiny, ESG risks) were not clearly bearish, so the explanation is tentative.

Cobalt|2022-08.lesson_en: After a cobalt price spike, watch for battery-chemistry substitution (LFP) and EV affordability pushback, which can cap demand and trigger sharp reversals.

Rising supply from Indonesia and new mines such as Idaho and Jervois's Brazil restart added to the glut (46, 18, 5). Cobalt|2023-03.lesson_en: Watch for new supply from Indonesia, Idaho and Brazil refinery restarts and for weak battery-demand signals, since they can outweigh Congo export disruption headlines.

Cobalt|2025-05.lesson_en: When a dominant producer facing a glut and depressed prices starts weighing intervention, watch for export bans or quotas that can quickly reverse the price trend.

Cobalt|2025-12.cause_en: DRC replaced its cobalt export ban with restrictive quotas, keeping supply tight.
Cobalt|2025-12.cause_zh: 刚果(金)以严格出口配额取代禁令,供应持续紧张
Cobalt|2025-12.explanation_en: After the DRC's export ban left the market short of material (July–August), Congo announced in September that the ban would be replaced by quotas from Oct 16. Quotas were firmly defended and permanent bans threatened for breaches. Producers were still waiting for export approvals in late October, and in December new export conditions and royalties tightened supply further. Cobalt hydroxide costs jumped and a US stockpiling push paused as prices soared.
Cobalt|2025-12.explanation_zh: 刚果(金)出口禁令在7–8月已造成原料偏紧。9月该国宣布自10月16日起以配额取代禁令,总统坚持配额制,并威胁永久禁止违规出口商。10月底生产商仍在等待出口批准,12月又出台新的出口条件和特许权使用费规则,进一步收紧供应。氢氧化钴成本大涨,美国国防部门的钴储备计划因价格飙升而暂停。
Cobalt|2025-12.lesson_en: When a dominant producer swaps a ban for quotas, watch the quota size and approval pace, since supply may stay tight well after the ban is lifted.
Cobalt|2025-12.lesson_zh: 当主要产区以配额取代禁令时,要关注配额规模和审批进度,因为禁令解除后供应仍可能长期偏紧。

None mention molybdenum prices, supply cuts, or demand changes in Feb–May 2018. Climax's permit news suggests continued operation rather than a supply loss, so the 59% rise cannot be attributed from these articles.
Molybdenum|2018-05.explanation_zh: 这些新闻多为科研论文和Climax矿水污染限值延期的地方报道,没有提到2018年2至5月钼价、减产或需求变化。Climax获准继续运营,并不意味着供应减少,因此无法凭这些标题解释钼价上涨59%。
Molybdenum|2018-05.lesson_en: Look for direct news on molybdenum supply, steel demand and by-product copper output, which these headlines lack.
Molybdenum|2018-05.lesson_zh: 应关注钼供应、钢铁需求和铜副产钼产量的直接新闻,而这些标题中缺少相关信息。

Molybdenum|2019-12.cause_en: Headlines do not explain the molybdenum price fall; only weak hints of supply-side news.
Molybdenum|2019-12.cause_zh: 新闻未能解释钼价下跌，仅有零星供应面线索
Molybdenum|2019-12.explanation_en: Most headlines are academic papers, unrelated "Moly" brand items, or company profiles, and none discusses molybdenum prices, demand, steel output or inventories. The only market-relevant items are mine-level news: a strike at Armenia's Agarak molybdenum combine [3], a legal challenge to Nevada's Mt. Hope mine [17], and China Molybdenum's loss-making Congo copper mine [7]. These do not clearly explain a 24% fall, so the cause cannot be determined from these headlines.
Molybdenum|2019-12.explanation_zh: 大部分标题是学术论文、与钼无关的“Moly”品牌内容或公司简介，没有任何一条谈及钼价、需求、钢铁产量或库存。仅有的与市场相关的是矿山层面的消息：亚美尼亚Agarak钼联合企业罢工[3]、内华达Mt. Hope钼矿面临法律挑战[17]，以及洛阳钼业刚果铜矿亏损[7]。这些都无法清楚解释24%的跌幅，因此仅凭这些标题无法确定原因。
Molybdenum|2019-12.lesson_en: Molybdenum price falls need steel-demand, tender and inventory news; mine-level or academic headlines alone cannot explain them.
Molybdenum|2019-12.lesson_zh: 解释钼价下跌需要钢铁需求、招标和库存方面的信息，仅靠矿山或学术类标题无法说明原因。

The timing (Mar–Jun 2020) fits the pandemic slump in industrial demand, and Freeport's May cut to Colorado molybdenum output [16] suggests supply was being reduced in response to weak prices and demand. The Tenke Fungurume strike after lockdown [22] shows pandemic disruption in related metals, but most other items are scientific or unrelated, so the evidence is thin.

Molybdenum|2020-06.lesson_en: In a demand-driven slump, watch for producer output cuts and lockdown-related disruption as signs of how deep the demand shock is.
Molybdenum|2020-06.lesson_zh: 需求驱动的下跌中,应关注生产商减产和封锁相关扰动,以判断需求冲击的深度。

Molybdenum|2021-07.lesson_zh: 当价格上涨却没有明显供应消息时,应关注钢铁行业需求复苏和市场评论,仅凭这些标题难以解释行情。

Lithium|2023-10.explanation_en: Headlines point to a lithium price rout in mid-2023, with Goldman Sachs urging a sell on MinRes and expecting more pain for prices, and brokers (E&P) saying prices would fall further as new mines open. Supply additions such as Zimbabwe's Chinese-built processing plant and the new mines weighed on prices, while LFP gains narrowed the nickel/cobalt gap. Later headlines (Oct) refer to a "price crash", though they are framed around future shortages, so the demand side is not clearly explained.
Lithium|2023-10.explanation_zh: 2023年年中锂价大幅下挫:高盛建议卖出MinRes并预期锂价还会承压,E&P等券商称随着新矿投产价格将进一步下跌。津巴布韦中资锂加工厂等新增供应加重了压力,磷酸铁锂追赶镍钴三元也影响需求结构。10月的报道直接提到"锂价暴跌",但多着眼于未来短缺,需求端原因在标题中并不清晰。
Lithium|2023-10.lesson_en: Watch broker downgrades and new mine/processing capacity ramp-ups, which often precede sharp lithium price corrections even amid bullish long-term narratives.
Lithium|2023-10.lesson_zh: 即使长期看多叙事盛行,券商下调评级和新矿/加工产能释放往往预示锂价将大幅回调,需要重点关注。

Lithium|2026-02.cause_zh: 储能需求爆发、中国取消出口退税及矿证吊销推高锂价
Lithium|2026-02.explanation_en: Lithium rebounded on China's energy-storage policy drive and booming battery demand, which tightened the outlook after a long slump (ids 23, 27, 38, 39). Supply-side shocks added fuel: Chinese authorities' plan to revoke mining licences in December and the announced removal of battery export tax rebates in January triggered spikes (35, 41). Speculative volatility, including a late-November plunge after trading curbs, did not stop the rally, which left prices tripled since June by February (32, 53).
Lithium|2026-02.explanation_zh: 在长期低迷之后，中国推动储能的政策和电池需求激增改善了锂的供需预期，推动价格反弹（23、27、38、39）。供给端与政策冲击进一步助推：12月中国地方政府计划吊销矿业许可证，1月中国宣布取消电池出口退税，引发价格飙升（35、41）。11月下旬因遏制投机交易出现过暴跌，但未能阻止涨势，到2月锂价较6月已上涨两倍（32、53）。
Lithium|2026-02.lesson_en: Watch Chinese energy-storage demand signals and Beijing's mining-licence and export-rebate policy, as these can quickly flip a depressed lithium market into a squeeze.

Alongside this, Lynas's bumper profit was attributed to EV and wind turbine demand, and Barron's noted huge gains in the rare-earth market by March. No headline gives hard price data, so the link is inferred from demand and policy-risk signals.

Rare Earths|2021-03.lesson_en: Watch for China export-policy rhetoric and Western supply-chain funding alongside EV and wind demand data, as these can precede rare earth price rallies.

Rare Earths|2021-09.lesson_en: Watch for demand forecasts tied to the energy transition and for supply-security policy shifts, which can tighten rare earth markets before concrete supply events appear.

Contributing demand-side signals include Tesla's plan to cut rare earths from next-generation EVs and commentary that Tesla was "hitting the brakes" [29][40]. Supply-side expansion news (Sweden's large deposit, Australian, Tanzanian and US discoveries and projects) added to a picture of growing future supply, though the headlines do not give detailed price mechanics [9][45][51]. Explanation is partial, as few headlines address Chinese domestic pricing.
Rare Earths|2023-05.explanation_zh: 新闻直接印证了2023年4—5月稀土价格暴跌,并拖累西方项目进展[54][57]。需求端方面,特斯拉计划在下一代电动车中减少稀土用量,相关评论也称特斯拉在"踩刹车"[29][40]。供给端,瑞典大型矿床、澳大利亚、坦桑尼亚及美国的新发现和新项目,强化了未来供应增加的预期[9][45][51]。不过标题对中国国内价格机制着墨不多,解释并不完整。
Rare Earths|2023-05.lesson_en: Watch for EV makers' moves to reduce rare earth magnet use and for signs of demand weakness, since price falls can follow quickly after peaks.

The only loosely relevant items are a mine collapse in Uganda (small producer), Tanzania's export approval, and Yunnan Tin's new smelter start-up, which are too minor to account for a 42% rise. The cause cannot be confirmed from these headlines.
Tin|2021-02.explanation_zh: 这些新闻多为矿业概况、康沃尔勘探报道和《Valheim》游戏攻略，没有直接涉及2020年11月至2021年2月的锡价、需求或供应中断。仅有乌干达矿井坍塌、坦桑尼亚获准出口、云南锡业新冶炼厂点火等零星信息，规模太小，难以解释42%的涨幅。因此仅凭这些标题无法确认原因。
Tin|2021-02.lesson_en: When headlines are generic, look to dedicated market data (inventories, Myanmar/Indonesia supply, electronics demand, shipping) rather than inferring causes from them.
Tin|2021-02.lesson_zh: 当新闻内容泛泛时，应转向库存、缅甸/印尼供应、电子需求和航运等专门市场数据，而不是凭这些标题推断原因。

Tin|2022-07.cause_en: Tin rally unwound as consumer demand weakened and supply recovered after record highs
Tin|2022-07.cause_zh: 需求疲软叠加供应恢复,锡价自历史高位回落
Tin|2022-07.explanation_en: Tin hit record highs in March 2022, but by April commentary noted prices were "flying high despite resurgent production", and global output had rebounded. By July, Reuters reported consumer belt-tightening hobbling demand for solder metal, so the earlier supply-squeeze premium unwound. Supply-side disruptions (Yunnan mine closure, Myanmar safety review) were not enough to offset weaker demand.
Tin|2022-07.explanation_zh: 锡价在2022年3月创历史新高,但4月已有评论指出产量回升而价格仍高企,全球产量在复苏。到7月,路透报道消费者紧缩开支拖累焊料用锡需求,前期供应紧张溢价消退。云南矿山关闭、缅甸安全审查等供应扰动不足以抵消需求走弱。
Tin|2022-07.lesson_en: When a supply-squeeze rally hits record highs while output is recovering, watch consumer demand signals, since weak demand can quickly reverse prices.
Tin|2022-07.lesson_zh: 当供应紧张推动的涨势创出纪录、而产量正在恢复时,要密切关注终端消费需求,需求走弱会让价格迅速反转。

Tin|2023-01.cause_en: Indonesia export-ban talk, Peru San Rafael halt, and China reopening hopes tightened tin supply
Tin|2023-01.cause_zh: 印尼出口禁令传闻与秘鲁圣拉斐尔停产推升锡价
Tin|2023-01.explanation_en: The clearest supply-side headline is Reuters on 20 Oct 2022, which reported that Indonesia, a top exporter, had not yet decided the timing of a tin export ban, signalling possible supply loss just as prices bottomed. In January 2023, San Rafael, Peru's major tin mine, was halted after protests [32]. Other headlines are mostly about mine development and history and do not explain the size of the rally, so the demand and macro drivers behind it are not evidenced here and confidence is limited.
Tin|2023-01.explanation_zh: 最明确的供应端线索是2022年10月20日路透社报道：全球主要出口国印尼尚未确定锡出口禁令的时间，暗示价格见底之际可能出现供应缺口。2023年1月，秘鲁大型锡矿San Rafael因抗议活动停产[32]。其余标题多为矿山开发和历史内容，无法解释涨幅的全部原因，需求和宏观因素在这些标题中没有证据，因此置信度有限。
Tin|2023-01.lesson_en: When a top exporter such as Indonesia discusses export bans, or a major mine faces unrest, expect a sharp supply-driven rally in thin tin markets.
Tin|2023-01.lesson_zh: 当印尼等主要出口国讨论出口禁令，或大型矿山面临动荡时，市场规模较小的锡可能出现由供应驱动的快速上涨。

Tin|2024-05.cause_en: Indonesian export slump, Myanmar Wa and DRC supply disruptions, falling stocks drove tin higher
Tin|2024-05.cause_zh: 印尼出口骤降、缅甸佤邦及刚果(金)供应受扰、库存下降推高锡价
Tin|2024-05.explanation_en: Headlines point to tightening supply: an Indonesian export slump tied to the PT Timah corruption case and resource nationalism, uncertainty over Myanmar's Wa State output, and M23 rebels disrupting supply routes in North Kivu. A Reuters commentary in April explicitly says falling stocks and more supply trouble sent tin skywards, while Fastmarkets noted prices near $32,000 on technology and renewables demand.
Tin|2024-05.explanation_zh: 新闻显示供应趋紧:印尼因PT Timah腐败案和资源民族主义导致出口大幅下滑,缅甸佤邦产量前景不明,M23叛军又扰乱北基伍省的供应通道。路透4月评论直言库存下降和供应问题推动锡价飙升,Fastmarkets also指出在科技和可再生能源需求支撑下,锡价逼近3.2万美元/吨。
Tin|2024-05.lesson_en: Watch for export disruptions in Indonesia, Myanmar and the DRC, since tin's thin market reacts sharply to supply shocks when stocks are low.
Tin|2024-05.lesson_zh: 关注印尼、缅甸和刚果(金)的出口与供应扰动;库存偏低时,锡这一小市场对供应冲击反应尤为剧烈。
